title: FOT Bonding Curve Price Growth Uses Nominal Price Instead of Actual Received
description: Price growth formula `config.price = price + (price * config.growthBasisPoints) / 10000` uses the nominal `price`, not `actualReceived`. For fee-on-transfer tokens (which the project explicitly supports per MockFOTToken.sol and NatSpec), the bonding curve advances faster than the actual value entering the protocol.
impact: Price diverges from economic reality over time. Later minters pay inflated prices relative to the actual value backing the system.
attackPath: Protocol is configured with a fee-on-transfer token
User mints an NFT at nominal price P
Actual received amount is P minus transfer fee
Price growth is calculated on nominal P, not actual received
Next mint price is higher than economically justified
Over many mints, cumulative divergence grows significantly
recommendation: Use actualReceived instead of nominal price when calculating price growth: `config.price = actualReceived + (actualReceived * config.growthBasisPoints) / 10000`.
